'''2013 Worlds Day 2 Walseth LS Careful Planning (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mark Walseth]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Name as written on the Day 2 sheet.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Careful Planning (V) (Virtual Block 4)|Careful Planning (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
